name: Standard Chess
desc: Classic FIDE rules. The foundation everything else is built on.

name: King of the Hill
desc: Move your king to the centre four squares for an instant win.

name: Three-Check
desc: Deliver three checks to win. No checkmate needed.

name: Antichess
desc: Captures are mandatory. Lose all your pieces to win.

name: Racing Kings
desc: No checks allowed. Race your king to rank 8.

name: Fischer Random
desc: 960 possible starting positions. King between rooks.

name: Rifle Chess
desc: Capturing pieces stay on their original square.

name: Atomic
desc: Captures explode, destroying adjacent pieces.

name: Marseillais
desc: Two moves per turn. Check ends your turn early.

name: Duck Chess
desc: Place a blocker duck after each move. Capture the king to win.

name: Fog of War
desc: You only see squares your pieces can reach.

name: Capablanca
desc: Archbishop and Chancellor on a wider board.

name: Grand Chess
desc: Same new pieces, bigger board, pawns start on rank 3.

name: Courier Chess
desc: Medieval German variant from the 1200s.

name: No Castling
desc: Standard chess, castling disabled. Endorsed by Kramnik.

name: Torpedo Chess
desc: Pawns can always double-move, not just from starting rank.

name: Horde Chess
desc: 36 pawns vs a normal army. Asymmetric survival.

name: Extinction Chess
desc: Lose when any piece type is fully eliminated.

name: Breakthrough
desc: Pawns only. First to reach the far rank wins.

name: Maharaja & Sepoys
desc: One Queen+Knight super-piece vs a full army.

name: Knightmate
desc: Knight is royal, king moves like a knight. Swap their roles.

name: Monster Chess
desc: White gets two moves per turn against Black's one.

name: Progressive
desc: Escalating moves each turn: 1, 2, 3, 4... Check ends it.

name: Chigorin
desc: White trades bishops for extra knights. Tactical imbalance.

name: Almost Chess
desc: One queen replaced by a Chancellor (Rook+Knight).

name: Amazon Chess
desc: Both queens replaced by Amazons (Queen+Knight compound).

name: Upside-Down
desc: Pieces start on opponent's rank. Pawns march backward.

name: Single-Check
desc: One check wins instantly. Every move is life or death.

name: Five-Check
desc: Deliver five checks to win. Longer than Three-Check.

name: Giveaway
desc: Forced captures. Lose all pieces to win. Stalemate = loss.

name: Suicide Chess
desc: Forced captures. Lose all pieces to win. Stalemate = draw.

name: Stalemate Wins
desc: Standard chess but stalemating your opponent wins.

name: Codrus
desc: Sacrifice your king to win. No check concept.

name: Makpong
desc: Thai variant: king cannot move out of check. Block or capture only.

name: Los Alamos
desc: No bishops, no castling. First computer chess (1956).

name: Minichess
desc: Full piece types on a tiny board. Fast and tactical.

name: Endgame Chess
desc: Only pawns and kings. Pure endgame from move one.

name: Peasants' Revolt
desc: King + pawns vs king + knights. Can the peasants win?

name: Pawns Only
desc: Only pawns. First to promote wins. Deceptively deep.
